mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (including potassium and magnesium), which can impair iron absorption and increase renal iron losses; iron may also enhance oxidative stress from amphotericin B's mechanisms.
action: Monitor serum iron, ferritin, and renal function regularly; consider separating administration times and assess need for iron supplementation or dose adjustment based on clinical response and laboratory parameters.
